{{Top|leg}}
A '''stir-stick''' was a tool used by members of the [[Laboi]] [[Species/Legends|species]] to tend their [[Crystal garden|gardens]] of [[Laboian mineral crystal]]s. The sticks were instrumental in turning wild, molten mineral deposits into ordered gardens. Nevertheless, stir-sticks were incapable of achieving the same fine-tuned results possible by those Laboi with [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetic]] abilities.<ref name="GG4b">[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races'', Second Edition]]</ref>
